meta_description: Your home library, shelf by shelf — scan books, find them on the shelf, share what you read.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
deletion_banner: Your account is scheduled for deletion.
verify_banner: Check your inbox to verify your email address.
landing_body: Catalogue your books by scanning their barcodes, always know which shelf they're on, and share what you read.
landing_point_scan: Scan ISBN barcodes with your phone camera
landing_point_shelves: Rooms, bookcases and shelves — with a sketch of where each book is
landing_point_log: A reading log with ratings, reviews and yearly goals
auth_use_magic: Sign in with an email link instead
auth_use_password: Sign in with a password instead
auth_create_subtitle: Free, no ads. Takes a minute.
auth_forgot_subtitle: We'll email you a link to choose a new one.

auth_check_reset: If an account exists for {email}, you'll get a reset link shortly.
auth_err_exists: An account with this email already exists.
auth_err_token: This link is invalid or has expired.
auth_err_rate: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth_err_terms: Please accept the terms to continue.
email_footer: If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email. Or paste this link into your browser:
email_verify_body: Tap the button below to confirm this address for your bok account.
email_reset_body: Someone asked to reset the password for this account. The link is valid for one hour.
email_magic_body: Tap the button to sign in. The link works once and expires in 15 minutes.
home_empty: Your library is empty. Start by scanning the books on one shelf.
home_feed_soon: Posts and reading updates from people you follow will appear here.
install_body: Add it to your home screen for full-screen scanning and quick access.
install_ios: Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
search_hint: Typing an ISBN goes straight to the book.
search_no_local: Nothing in bok yet — try the results below.
isbn_invalid: That isn't a valid ISBN or ISSN.
isbn_invalid_hint: Check the digits — the last one is a checksum.
isbn_not_found: We couldn't find this book in any catalogue.
isbn_not_found_hint: Adding books by hand is coming in the next update.
scan_camera_soon_hint: For now, type the ISBN printed above the barcode.
lists_soon_hint: Private and public lists you can share with anyone, even without an account.
settings_avatar_failed: Upload failed. Try a different image.
settings_err_timezone: Pick a time zone from the list.
settings_delete_explain: Your account and all your data are permanently deleted 14 days after you confirm. Sign in before then to cancel.
settings_delete_scheduled: Your account will be permanently deleted on {date}. Other devices were signed out.
legal_draft_notice: Draft — to be reviewed before public launch.
privacy_what_body: Your email, name, profile details and photo, the books in your library and the reading data you enter. We don't sell data or show ads.
privacy_where_body: On our own servers in the EU. Photos are stored in Cloudflare R2. Emails are delivered by Resend. Book metadata is looked up at Open Library, Google Books and the National Library of Poland — only the ISBN is sent.
privacy_cookies_body: Only what's needed to keep you signed in and remember your language and theme. No tracking or analytics cookies.
privacy_rights_body: You can edit your data at any time and delete your account in Settings. Under GDPR you can also ask us for a copy of your data.
terms_body_1: bok is a personal library and reading community. Be kind; don't post anything illegal, hateful or that infringes others' rights.
terms_body_2: You keep the rights to what you write. You let us display it according to the visibility you choose.
terms_body_3: The service is provided as is. We may suspend accounts that abuse it.
scan_denied_hint: Allow camera access for this site in your browser settings, or type the ISBN below.
scan_unavailable_hint: You can still type ISBNs by hand.
scan_aim: Aim at the barcode on the back cover
scan_aim_check: Scan to check if you already have it
scan_check_hint: Scan a book in a shop or at a friend's to see whether it's already in your library.
scan_empty_hint: Scan books one after another — each one is added right away and can be undone.
scan_status_offline: Saved — will be added when you're online
verdict_offline: Offline — checked against {count} books saved on this device

search_add_manual: Not here? Add it by hand
